//: The pure half of the domain (mono-7): portfolio maths, the two display-format modules, the glossary automaton, the due-date grammar, the view-filter matcher, document extraction and policy, identity normalization, and the attribute registry's pure quartet. The property this package exists to hold is stated as a test, not a convention — `src/purity.test.ts` fails the build on a `drizzle-orm` import, a React import, a `process.env` read, or a value (as opposed to type) import of @spaces/db.
name: @spaces/core
//exports: Source entry points, not a build output: every consumer is bundled by vite or loaded by tsx/vitest, all of which resolve TypeScript through `exports`. One subpath per domain, so an `#/lib/<domain>/<module>` import became `@spaces/core/<domain>/<module>` with nothing else changing — `./documents` is spelled twice because the old bare-directory specifier resolved to its index.
//dependencies: unpdf, mammoth and fflate arrived with documents/extract.ts, tldts with entities/normalize.ts, zod with the attribute value validators. Not here, and the test enforces it: drizzle-orm, react, and anything that reads the environment.
//devDependencies: @spaces/db is a devDependency on purpose: spec §2 allows core → db, but only for the column payload types (`AttributeOptions`, `SelectOption`, `ObjectKind`, `BadgeColor`, the view condition shapes), which `import type` erases at compile. A runtime dependency would mean core can reach the database, which is the one thing this package promises it cannot.
